purpose: Preserve the chronological history of authoritative property fixture governance validation states without overwriting prior status records.
history_rules: Each material status state receives a new immutable history entry.
Historical entries cannot be silently rewritten.
A new entry must identify the event or validation run that caused the state.
Technical status history is separate from legal-source history.
Technical status history is separate from publication history.
guardrails: History is technical governance history only.
It does not establish Irish property-law correctness.
It does not establish live property facts.
Historical states remain available even after later states are recorded.
